headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a dominant 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Jordan Walker leading the offense. In other news, the Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs 3-0, and the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Chicago Cubs right-handed pitcher Edward Cabrera, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle-finger blister. The Tampa Bay Rays have also placed right fielder Jonny DeLuca on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

The Philadelphia Phillies made a roster move ahead of a series, trading right-handed pitcher Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, coming out on top in a closely contested game. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Walker leading the offense. Walker's impressive performance included three hits, two home runs, and three RBIs, with his second homer being a line drive to left center field.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, securing a win on the road. Patrick Corbin led the Blue Jays to victory, pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cubs RHP Cabrera Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs right-handed pitcher Edward Cabrera has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle-finger blister, effective retroactive to May 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies have traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
